chapter: Armstrong, the Elite and New Orleans scene
title: Identifying musicians in a photograph of the Hines and Russell bands
summary: Shown photos, Handy tries to identify a Hines saxophonist (Simeon?), and recalls Albert Nicholas and Big Eye in Luis Russell's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
